en: Dependent on a state that is not associated with pleasant feeling and is not a root (nahetu), a state that is associated with pleasant feeling and is a root arises by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya).

Dependent on a state that is not associated with pleasant feeling and is not a root, a state that is associated with painful feeling and is a root arises by way of root-condition. [Dependent on a state] not associated with pleasant feeling...

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is not-root (nahetu), there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is root (hetu) by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*) … three.
Dependent on a state associated with feeling other than pain that is not-root, there arises a state associated with painful feeling that is root by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is not a root, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is a root, by way of root condition. … Three.

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is not a root, and also dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling that is not a root, there arises a state associated with pleasant feeling that is a root, by way of root condition.

… three. (The second time, counted by the calculator: three. Under the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*), twenty-one; … pe … under the result condition (*vipāka*), fourteen; … pe … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), twenty-one.
Dependent on a state that is not associated with pleasant feeling and is not a root, a state that is associated with painful feeling and is a root arises by way of the root condition:
two. Dependent on a state that is not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and is not a root: … (only two questions).

In dependence on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and not-rooted... [In the root condition: nine... pe... [in the result condition: six... pe... [in the non-disappearance condition: nine.
